crossRefs.note: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.

translations.web: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.
translations.bsb: Like charcoal for embers and wood for fire, so is a quarrelsome man for kindling strife.
translations.kjv: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.
translations.asv: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, So is a contentious man to inflame strife.
